summary: Sony's London-set crime action series, including the PSP spin-off Gangs of London and the canceled The Getaway 3.

entries.title: The Getaway

emulation.notes: Original PS2 hardware is the reference route; PCSX2 can upscale with normal sixth-generation caveats.

primary.why: The Getaway released exclusively for PlayStation 2. PS2 is the only sourced release and therefore the primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PlayStation 2 hardware or use PCSX2 with owned media for upscaling and preservation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one sourced platform release exists.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is documented in the cited public source; later printings removed some real-world branding after complaints.

entries.title: Gangs of London

emulation.notes: Original PSP hardware is the reference route; PPSSPP can upscale for preservation.

primary.why: Gangs of London is the third game and PSP spin-off of The Getaway series. PlayStation Portable is the only sourced release and therefore the primary route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PSP hardware or use PPSSPP with owned media for higher-resolution preservation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one sourced platform release exists.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern game remaster is documented in the cited public source; the later Gangs of London TV series is an adaptation, not a game release.
